name_en: Shijimi jiru — miso soup with Lake Biwa's endemic seta shijimi clam
summary_ja: 琵琶湖の固有種セタシジミを昆布だしと合わせた味噌汁。他のシジミより殻が大きく身にコクがあるとされ、産卵前の春が特に美味とされる。近年は漁獲量の減少で貴重になってきているという。
summary_en: A miso soup built on seta shijimi, a clam found only in Lake Biwa, simmered in a kelp-based broth. Plumper and richer than other shijimi species, it is said to taste best in spring before spawning, though catches have grown scarce in recent years.

name_en: Uchimame jiru — miso soup with hand-pounded flattened soybeans
summary_ja: 蒸した大豆を木づちで一粒ずつ潰して乾燥させた打ち豆を、かぶや里芋とともに味噌汁に仕立てた湖北地域の料理。雪深い冬の貴重なたんぱく源とされ、報恩講のお講汁としても振る舞われると伝わる。
summary_en: Soybeans, steamed and hand-flattened one by one with a wooden mallet before drying, are simmered with turnip and taro into a miso soup from Lake Biwa's snowy north. Once a vital winter protein source, it is also served at Buddhist memorial gatherings.

name_en: Dongame jiru — miso soup of scored eggplant and sesame
summary_ja: なすの皮に格子状の切れ目を入れてだし汁で煮て、味噌とすりごまを溶き入れた夏の汁物。近江商人の町、五個荘で生まれたとされ、汁のごまが泥、なすの甲羅模様が亀に見えることが名の由来という。
summary_en: Eggplant scored with a crosshatch pattern is simmered in dashi, then finished with miso and ground sesame. Said to originate in the merchant town of Gokasho, the name compares the muddy look of the sesame in the broth and the eggplant's scored skin to a turtle's shell.
